name: Álvaro Schocair
affiliation: Founder & CEO, Link School of Business
bio: Entrepreneur, investor, and education innovator reimagining higher education through entrepreneurship. Álvaro founded Link School of Business, an ecosystem combining education, venture capital, and startup acceleration that has helped launch more than 240 student-led startups.

name: Andrés Preschel
bio: Applied physiologist and health optimization consultant for high performers, helping clients harness physiological awareness for better performance, disease prevention, and longevity. Founder of Know Your Physio and host of a top 1% health podcast.

name: Wilma de Souza
bio: Business and investment strategist with an 18-year track record spanning investment banking and international business development, from Wall Street to boardrooms across five continents. Certified in Venture Capital and Investor Due Diligence by Columbia Business School.

name: Eduardo Lins Henrique
bio: Co-founder of Empower Business School, a mentorship and course platform helping professionals reach leadership positions in an increasingly global, competitive market. Completed his first marathon at 47 and an Ironman 70.3, bringing the same discipline to business mentorship.
